motor_mass_source: User estimate: approximately 70 g per complete servo
joint_reference: URDF zero is the current CAD pose; Fusion limits shifted by current joint value
limitations: Motor mass is a user-supplied 70 g estimate per complete servo; inertia is uniformly scaled from CAD.
Printed parts use an affine shell/core approximation, not slicer toolpaths.
Base bearing uses user-supplied 105 g mass; its CAD COM is retained and inertia uniformly scaled.
All remaining bodies use PLA, 30% infill, 6 perimeters, and 6 top/bottom layers.

Adaptive boxes enclose all cut fragments, reducing concave overfill. A 32-box budget per selected body prevents reaching the 85% fill target; circular boundaries and small cavities remain approximate. Other bodies in link3_1 use one oriented box each.

All bodies use adaptive box collisions. Native fragments are enclosed conservatively; a 32-box budget and minimum split size can stop fitting before the 65% fill target. Curves and small cavities remain approximate. Visual geometry stays as meshes.
